crossRefs.note: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order…
Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.
For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to…
I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,
But I have this against you, that you left your first love.
Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly…

translations.web: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.
translations.bsb: and thus will incur judgment because they are setting aside their first faith.
translations.kjv: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
translations.asv: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.
